title: solution.tex resolves only G1; Fact (II) (signature factors through Pontryagin numbers) is assumed with no companion section

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
**Where:** `solution.tex` — Scope paragraph; "What is proved here"; Section 2 facts (I)/(II); Corollary `cor:agree`; final Remark.

**Observation (specific to this attempt).** The submitted solution is, by its own framing, a *self-contained resolution of G1* (rm-01541-2): the spanning family $M_\mu=\prod_s\mathbb{CP}^{2\mu_s}$ with a triangular dominance-order determinant. That section is **correct** (I verified $\det A=3,90,17010,1653372000$ for $k=1,2,3,4$, matching the Remark; and $[h^{2m}](h/\tanh h)^{2m+1}=1$). It also correctly writes the $\mathbb{CP}^{2k}$ foundations (G5).

**Gap.** Corollary `cor:agree` concludes "$\tau(M)=L[M]$ for every closed oriented $4k$-manifold $M$" by invoking, as a black box,

> **(II)** In each degree $4k$ there exist $a_\lambda\in\mathbb{Q}$ with $\tau(M)=\sum_\lambda a_\lambda p_\lambda[M]$ for **all** closed oriented $4k$-manifolds $M$, "supplied elsewhere in the proof."

There is **no companion section**: `solution.tex` contains only the spanning write-up. Fact (II) is the analytic/topological heart of the theorem. Classically it needs:
  1. **cobordism invariance of the signature** $\tau(\partial W)=0$ (Thom-Rokhlin; provable elementarily via Poincare-Lefschetz duality / 'half lives, half dies' — this is exactly **G3 = rm-01541-4**); and
  2. that $\tau$ **factors through Pontryagin numbers**, which classically is the structure of $\Omega^{SO}_*\otimes\mathbb{Q}$ as a polynomial algebra detected by Pontryagin numbers — i.e. the **cobordism theory the problem explicitly forbids**.

So the single imported fact (II) is precisely the substance of part (a). The spanning step does NOT close the theorem on its own; the agreement on the family extends to all $M$ ONLY because (II) is asserted for all $M$.

**Required to close:**
  - a cobordism-free proof of (II) for all closed oriented $4k$-manifolds (sub-lemma G3 + the 'factors-through-Pontryagin-numbers' upgrade), OR
  - an honest restatement: relabel (II) as the open sub-lemma G3 instead of 'supplied elsewhere' (no such section exists).

**Scope note.** This issue records the *structural* status of the current attempt; the underlying hard sub-lemma is already tracked by **rm-01541-4 (G3)**. Parts (b) and the $\tau$-multiplicativity step remain open under **rm-01541-7 (G6)** and **rm-01541-3 (G2)** respectively; they are also absent from `solution.tex`.
